caption:
UWS Briefly · Oct 29 – Nov 4

• Micah Lasher won the NY-12 seat in Congress. Hochul won too.
• Workers took the roof off the water tower where the barn owls nest. The building got a cease-and-desist order.
• A 24-year-old woman running her first NYC Marathon collapsed in Central Park, two miles from the finish, and died.
• The McDonald's at 2726 Broadway, near 104th, closed for good on Halloween.
• A 41-year-old woman was robbed at knifepoint at Central Park West and 107th on Oct. 27.
• Zip code 10024 is now the wealthiest in the country, says the Business Journals. 10023 is second. Your landlord knows.
• A 10-story condo with exactly four apartments is planned for 79th and Columbus, across from the museum.
• Dead chickens turned up on the Broadway median near 90th again. Fifth time since 2024.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by West Side Rag, I Love the Upper West Side.
